claim: Q2 2026 orders were $24.2B (+88% organic) and revenue $11.1B (+22%, +12% organic); backlog $176B; gas power equipment backlog plus slot reservation agreements grew from 100 GW to 116 GW, comprising 53 GW backlog and 63 GW slot reservations; FY26 guidance raised to revenue $45.5-46.5B and free cash flow $11.5-12.5B.

title: GE Vernova 2Q 2026 gas turbine output plan
claim: Gas turbine output is planned at 20 GW annualised in Q3 2026, 24 GW in 2028 and 30 GW in 2030, against 116 GW already under contract or reservation.

title: GE Vernova Electrification segment second quarter 2026
claim: Electrification orders were $6.3B (+66% organic) with a book-to-bill of about 1.7 and equipment backlog of $40.6B (+69% y/y); data-centre orders exceeded $5B year-to-date, more than double the 2025 total.

title: Vertiv reports strong second quarter 2026 and raises full year 2026 guidance
claim: Q2 2026 net sales were $3,274M (+24%, 18% organic) with adjusted operating margin of 22.6% (+410bp); FY26 guidance is net sales $13.8-14.2B, organic growth 30-32% and adjusted free cash flow $2.4-2.6B.

title: Vertiv second quarter 2026 release omits orders and backlog
claim: The Q2 2026 earnings release discloses no orders, no backlog and no book-to-bill figure, which was the metric the W29 thesis identified as the key open question for this name.

title: NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy merger regulatory applications
claim: NextEra and Dominion filed regulatory applications on 2026-07-15 for a combination that would create the largest US regulated electric utility at about 10 million customer accounts, including $2.25B of bill credits for Dominion customers, with closing expected in late 2027.

title: Electricity 2026 — Executive Summary and Demand
claim: Global electricity demand is forecast to grow 3.6% a year over 2026-2030, about 50% faster than the previous decade average; global data-centre consumption rises from 415 TWh in 2024 to roughly 945 TWh in 2030, with data-centre demand up 17% in 2025 and AI-focused data centres up 50%.

title: Annual Energy Outlook 2026
claim: US electricity demand is projected to grow 0.9%-1.6% a year through 2050 across cases, against 2.1% annually over the past five years; installed generating capacity rises 50%-90% by 2050. Data centres are named the dominant driver of long-term growth, but the national demand growth rate is far more modest than the theme narrative implies.

title: PJM 2027/2028 base residual capacity auction result
claim: The 2027/2028 base residual auction cleared at the FERC-approved cap of $333.44/MW-day across the footprint and still fell 6,623 MW short of the reliability requirement.

title: FERC rejects amended interconnection agreement for behind-the-meter load at Susquehanna
claim: FERC rejected on a 2-1 vote the amended interconnection service agreement that would have expanded AWS behind-the-meter load at Talen Susquehanna, citing fairness and reliability; the arrangement is moving to a front-of-the-meter structure. title: Eaton reports record second quarter 2026 results

title: Hyperscaler capital expenditure, Q1 2026 versus Q1 2025, from 10-Q filings

claim: Combined Q1 2026 capital expenditure across Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta was $129.8B against $71.9B in Q1 2025, up 80%. title: Hyperscaler capex run-rate against full-year guidance
claim: Q1 2026 combined capital expenditure of $129.8B annualises to $519B, materially below the roughly $725B full-year aggregate reported in the press. Reaching that figure requires spending well above the Q1 run-rate across the remaining quarters, which makes the widely-cited aggregate a forward commitment rather than an established rate.
